verses.en: The burden of the valley of vision. What aileth thee now, that thou art wholly gone up to the housetops?
verses.pt: Oráculo acerca do vale da visão. Que tens agora, pois que com todos os teus subiste aos telhados?
verses.en_web: The burden of the valley of vision. What ails you now, that you have all gone up to the housetops?
verses.en_bbe: The word about the valley of vision. Why have all your people gone up to the house-tops?

verses.en: Thou that art full of stirs, a tumultuous city, a joyous city: thy slain men are not slain with the sword, nor dead in battle.
verses.pt: e tu que estás cheia de clamor, cidade turbulenta, cidade alegre; os teus mortos não são mortos à espada, nem mortos em guerra.
verses.en_web: You that are full of shouting, a tumultuous city, a joyous town; your slain are not slain with the sword, neither are they dead in battle.
verses.en_bbe: You, who are full of loud voices, a town of outcries, given up to joy; your dead men have not been put to the sword, or come to their death in war.

verses.en: All thy rulers are fled together, they are bound by the archers: all that are found in thee are bound together, which have fled from far.
verses.pt: Todos os teus homens principais juntamente fugiram, sem o arco foram presos; todos os que em ti se acharam, foram presos juntamente, embora tivessem fugido para longe.
verses.en_web: All your rulers fled away together. They were bound by the archers. All who were found by you were bound together. They fled far away.
verses.en_bbe: All your rulers ... have gone in flight; all your strong ones have gone far away.

verses.en: Therefore said I, Look away from me; I will weep bitterly, labour not to comfort me, because of the spoiling of the daughter of my people.
verses.pt: Portanto digo: Desviai de mim a vista, e chorarei amargamente; não vos canseis mais em consolar-me pela destruição da filha do meu povo.
verses.en_web: Therefore I said, “Look away from me. I will weep bitterly. Don’t labor to comfort me for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
verses.en_bbe: For this cause I have said, Let your eyes be turned away from me in my bitter weeping; I will not be comforted for the wasting of the daughter of my people.

verses.en: For it is a day of trouble, and of treading down, and of perplexity by the Lord GOD of hosts in the valley of vision, breaking down the walls, and of crying to the mountains.
verses.pt: Porque dia de destroço, de atropelamento, e de confusão é este da parte do Senhor Deus dos exércitos, no vale da visão; um derrubar de muros, e um clamor até as montanhas.
verses.en_web: For it is a day of confusion, and of treading down, and of perplexity, from the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, in the valley of vision; a breaking down of the walls, and a crying to the mountains.”
verses.en_bbe: For it is a day of trouble and of crushing down and of destruction from the Lord, the Lord of armies, in the valley of vision; ...

verses.en: And Elam bare the quiver with chariots of men and horsemen, and Kir uncovered the shield.
verses.pt: Elão tomou a aljava, juntamente com carros e cavaleiros, e Quir descobriu os escudos.
verses.en_web: Elam carried his quiver, with chariots of men and horsemen; and Kir uncovered the shield.
verses.en_bbe: And Elam was armed with arrows, and Aram came on horseback; and the breastplate of Kir was uncovered.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that thy choicest valleys shall be full of chariots, and the horsemen shall set themselves in array at the gate.
verses.pt: Os teus mais formosos vales ficaram cheios de carros, e os cavaleiros postaram-se contra as portas.
verses.en_web: Your choicest valleys were full of chariots, and the horsemen set themselves in array at the gate.
verses.en_bbe: And your most fertile valleys were full of war-carriages, and the horsemen took up their positions in front of the town.

verses.en: And he discovered the covering of Judah, and thou didst look in that day to the armour of the house of the forest.
verses.pt: Tirou-se a cobertura de Judá; e naquele dia olhaste para as armas da casa do bosque.
verses.en_web: He took away the covering of Judah; and you looked in that day to the armor in the house of the forest.
verses.en_bbe: He took away the cover of Judah; and in that day you were looking with care at the store of arms in the house of the woods.

verses.en: Ye have seen also the breaches of the city of David, that they are many: and ye gathered together the waters of the lower pool.
verses.pt: E vistes que as brechas da cidade de Davi eram muitas; e ajuntastes as águas da piscina de baixo;
verses.en_web: You saw the breaches of David’s city, that they were many; and you gathered together the waters of the lower pool.
verses.en_bbe: And you saw all the broken places in the wall of the town of David: and you got together the waters of the lower pool.

verses.en: And ye have numbered the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses have ye broken down to fortify the wall.
verses.pt: e contastes as casas de Jerusalém, e derrubastes as casas, para fortalecer os muros;
verses.en_web: You counted the houses of Jerusalem, and you broke down the houses to fortify the wall.
verses.en_bbe: And you had the houses of Jerusalem numbered, pulling down the houses to make the wall stronger.

verses.en: Ye made also a ditch between the two walls for the water of the old pool: but ye have not looked unto the maker thereof, neither had respect unto him that fashioned it long ago.
verses.pt: fizestes também um reservatório entre os dois muros para as águas da piscina velha; mas não olhastes para aquele que o tinha feito, nem considerastes o que o formou desde a antiguidade.
verses.en_web: You also made a reservoir between the two walls for the water of the old pool. But you didn’t look to him who had done this, neither did you have respect for him who purposed it long ago.
verses.en_bbe: And you made a place between the two walls for storing the waters of the old pool: but you gave no thought to him who had done this, and were not looking to him by whom it had been purposed long before.

verses.en: And in that day did the Lord GOD of hosts call to weeping, and to mourning, and to baldness, and to girding with sackcloth:
verses.pt: O Senhor Deus dos exércitos vos convidou naquele dia para chorar e prantear, para rapar a cabeça e cingir o cilício;
verses.en_web: In that day, the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, called to weeping, and to mourning, and to baldness, and to dressing in sackcloth:
verses.en_bbe: And in that day the Lord, the Lord of armies, was looking for weeping, and cries of sorrow, cutting off of the hair, and putting on the clothing of grief:

verses.en: And behold joy and gladness, slaying oxen, and killing sheep, eating flesh, and drinking wine: let us eat and drink; for to morrow we shall die.
verses.pt: mas eis aqui gozo e alegria; matam-se bois, degolam-se ovelhas, come-se carne, bebe-se vinho, e se diz: Comamos e bebamos, porque amanhã morreremos.
verses.en_web: and behold, joy and gladness, killing cattle and killing sheep, eating meat and drinking wine: “Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we will die.”
verses.en_bbe: But in place of these there was joy and delight, oxen and sheep were being made ready for food, there was feasting and drinking: men said, Now is the time for food and wine, for tomorrow death comes.

verses.en: And it was revealed in mine ears by the LORD of hosts, Surely this iniquity shall not be purged from you till ye die, saith the Lord GOD of hosts.
verses.pt: Mas o Senhor dos exércitos revelou-se aos meus ouvidos, dizendo: Certamente esta maldade não se vos perdoará até que morrais, diz o Senhor Deus dos exércitos.
verses.en_web: Yahweh of Armies revealed himself in my ears, “Surely this iniquity will not be forgiven you until you die,” says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord of armies said to me secretly, Truly, this sin will not be taken from you till your death, says the Lord, the Lord of armies.

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD of hosts, Go, get thee unto this treasurer, even unto Shebna, which is over the house, and say,
verses.pt: Assim diz o Senhor Deus dos exércitos: Anda, vai ter com esse administrador, Sebna, o mordomo, e pergunta-lhe:
verses.en_web: Thus says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, “Go, get yourself to this treasurer, even to Shebna, who is over the house, and say,
verses.en_bbe: The Lord, the Lord of armies, says, Go to this person in authority, this Shebna, who is over the house; who has made himself a resting-place on high, cutting out a place for himself in the rock, and say,

verses.en: What hast thou here? and whom hast thou here, that thou hast hewed thee out a sepulchre here, as he that heweth him out a sepulchre on high, and that graveth an habitation for himself in a rock?
verses.pt: Que fazes aqui? ou que parente tens tu aqui, para que cavasses aqui uma sepultura? Cavando em lugar alto a tua sepultura, cinzelando na rocha morada para ti mesmo!
verses.en_web: ‘What are you doing here? Who has you here, that you have dug out a tomb here?’ Cutting himself out a tomb on high, chiseling a habitation for himself in the rock!”
verses.en_bbe: Who are you, and by what right have you made for yourself a resting-place here?

verses.en: Behold, the LORD will carry thee away with a mighty captivity, and will surely cover thee.
verses.pt: Eis que o Senhor te arrojará violentamente, ó homem forte, e seguramente te prenderá.
verses.en_web: Behold, Yahweh will overcome you and hurl you away violently. Yes, he will grasp you firmly.
verses.en_bbe: See, O strong man, the Lord will send you violently away, gripping you with force,

verses.en: He will surely violently turn and toss thee like a ball into a large country: there shalt thou die, and there the chariots of thy glory shall be the shame of thy lord’s house.
verses.pt: Certamente te enrolará como uma bola, e te lançará para um país espaçoso. Ali morrerás, e ali irão os teus magníficos carros, ó tu, opróbrio da casa do teu senhor.
verses.en_web: He will surely wind you around and around, and throw you like a ball into a large country. There you will die, and there the chariots of your glory will be, you shame of your lord’s house.
verses.en_bbe: Twisting you round and round like a ball he will send you out into a wide country: there you will come to your end, and there will be the carriages of your pride, O shame of your lord's house!

verses.en: And I will drive thee from thy station, and from thy state shall he pull thee down.
verses.pt: E demitir-te-ei do teu posto; e da tua categoria serás derrubado.
verses.en_web: I will thrust you from your office. You will be pulled down from your station.
verses.en_bbe: And I will have you forced out of your place of authority, and pulled down from your position.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah:
verses.pt: Naquele dia chamarei a meu servo Eliaquim, filho de Hilquias,
verses.en_web: It will happen in that day that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah,
verses.en_bbe: And in that day I will send for my servant, Eliakim, the son of Hilkiah:

verses.en: And I will clothe him with thy robe, and strengthen him with thy girdle, and I will commit thy government into his hand: and he shall be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah.
verses.pt: e vesti-lo-ei da tua túnica, e cingi-lo-ei com o teu cinto, e entregarei nas suas mãos o teu governo; e ele será como pai para os moradores de Jerusalém, e para a casa de Judá.
verses.en_web: and I will clothe him with your robe, and strengthen him with your belt. I will commit your government into his hand; and he will be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah.
verses.en_bbe: And I will put your robe on him, and put your band about him, and I will give your authority into his hand: and he will be a father to the men of Jerusalem, and to the family of Judah.

verses.en: And the key of the house of David will I lay upon his shoulder; so he shall open, and none shall shut; and he shall shut, and none shall open.
verses.pt: Porei a chave da casa de Davi sobre o seu ombro; ele abrirá, e ninguém fechará; fechará, e ninguém abrirá.
verses.en_web: I will lay the key of David’s house on his shoulder. He will open, and no one will shut. He will shut, and no one will open.
verses.en_bbe: And I will give the key of the family of David into his care; and what he keeps open will be shut by no one, and what he keeps shut no one will make open.

verses.en: And I will fasten him as a nail in a sure place; and he shall be for a glorious throne to his father’s house.
verses.pt: E fixá-lo-ei como a um prego num lugar firme; e será como um trono de honra para a casa de seu pai.
verses.en_web: I will fasten him like a nail in a sure place. He will be for a throne of glory to his father’s house.
verses.en_bbe: And I will put him like a nail in a safe place; and he will be for a seat of glory to his father's family.

verses.en: And they shall hang upon him all the glory of his father’s house, the offspring and the issue, all vessels of small quantity, from the vessels of cups, even to all the vessels of flagons.
verses.pt: Nele, pois, pendurarão toda a glória da casa de seu pai, a prole e a progênie, todos os vasos menores, desde as taças até os jarros.
verses.en_web: They will hang on him all the glory of his father’s house, the offspring and the issue, every small vessel, from the cups even to all the pitchers.
verses.en_bbe: And all the glory of his father's family will be hanging on him, all their offspring, every small vessel, even the cups and the basins.

verses.en: In that day, saith the LORD of hosts, shall the nail that is fastened in the sure place be removed, and be cut down, and fall; and the burden that was upon it shall be cut off: for the LORD hath spoken it.
verses.pt: Naquele dia, diz o Senhor dos exércitos, cederá o prego fincado em lugar firme; será cortado, e cairá; e a carga que nele estava se desprenderá, porque o Senhor o disse.
verses.en_web: “In that day,” says Yahweh of Armies, “the nail that was fastened in a sure place will give way. It will be cut down, and fall. The burden that was on it will be cut off, for Yahweh has spoken it.”
verses.en_bbe: In that day, says the Lord of armies, will the nail fixed in a safe place give way; and it will be cut down, and in its fall the weight hanging on it will be cut off, for the Lord has said it.
